dataset.citation: Chen, D. (2015). Online Retail. UCI Machine Learning Repository. https://doi.org/10.24432/C5BW33

request.question: Which products and countries contributed most to net invoice value over the complete recorded period, and how much did cancellations reduce it?

objective.metric: Sum Quantity multiplied by UnitPrice in GBP, grouped separately by StockCode and Country. Retain source decimal precision; round only displayed currency. Report C-prefixed invoice cancellation value separately. This is invoice-line value, not audited revenue or profit.
objective.population: Every original row in the pinned historical source snapshot. Preserve missing customer/product descriptions and duplicate-looking lines; flag unusual prices and quantities without silent exclusions.
objective.period: 2010-12-01 through 2011-12-09 inclusive, using the source wall-clock dates. The final month is partial and the source timezone is unknown.
expected_checks: Reconcile processed, excluded, failed and pending rows with the complete source row count.
Reconcile overall, product and country totals using exact decimal arithmetic.
Compare the accepted result with an independent calculation over the unchanged CSV.
Preserve cancellation signs, missing identifiers, unusual prices and tied rankings. Explain any alternative treatment.
objective.freshness: Pinned historical snapshot. Identify the source period and fingerprint; do not present it as current business activity.
open_questions: No business growth target or alert threshold is supplied; produce a descriptive baseline.
The source timezone is unknown; preserve source wall-clock dates.
Negative prices and negative quantities without cancellation identifiers require explicit interpretation, not silent removal.
